name: Responsive Post with Category Tab
author: Patel Ketan

sections.description:
You can download plugin Pvkmnrs Responsive Post with Category Tab. you are in a way giving a very professional touch to it. Your customer might like the professional and fancy vibe of your site with category tab layout…

Download Now it today and explore all the features.

☑️ Features :

The plugin work with shortcode so you can easily display Category Tab show anywhere on your site.

☑️ Here is the plugin shortcode example

Post Category Tab

[pvkmnrs_category_tab]

Here is Template code

☑️ Use Following parameters with shortcode

[pvkmnrs_category_tab]

  • Category Limit:
    [pvkmnrs_category_tab cat_limit=”0″]
    Display number of category tab. you pass limit value “0” then all category tab display.

  • Category Order:
    [pvkmnrs_category_tab cat_order=”0″]
    Display category tab order. Parameter value “asc” OR “desc”. Default value “asc”.

  • Category Orderby:
    [pvkmnrs_category_tab cat_orderby=”name”]
    Display order by category tab. ie name, term_id, count etc.

  • Parent Category:
    [pvkmnrs_category_tab child_of=””]
    Enter parent category ID to retrieve all child terms of. You can find id at relevant category listing page.

  • Display Specific Category:
    [pvkmnrs_category_tab cat_id=””]
    Enter category id. You can pass multiple ids with comma seperated. You can find id at relevant category listing page.

  • Display Child Category:
    [pvkmnrs_category_tab include_cat_child=”true”]
    If you are using parent category then whether to display child category or not. Parameter values are “true” or “false”.

  • Post Order:
    [pvkmnrs_category_tab order=”desc”]
    Display post order. Parameter value “asc” OR “desc”. Default value “desc”.

  • Post Orderby:
    [pvkmnrs_category_tab orderby=”date”]
    Order by post ie ID, author, title, date, name, rand etc.

  • Limit:
    [pvkmnrs_category_tab limit=”15″]
    Display number of post. you pass limit value “-1” then all post display.

  • Grid:
    [pvkmnrs_category_tab grid=”3″]
    Display post grid wise. You can display 1 to 5 Grid. Default grid value 3.

  • Display Author:
    [pvkmnrs_category_tab display_author=”true”]
    Display author name. Parameter value “true” OR “false”. Default value “true”.

  • Display Date:
    [pvkmnrs_category_tab display_date=”true”]
    Display post date. Parameter value “true” OR “false”. Default value “true”.

  • Display Content:
    [pvkmnrs_category_tab display_content=”true”]
    Display post content. Parameter value “true” OR “false”. Default value “true”.

  • Display Full Content:
    [pvkmnrs_category_tab display_full_content=”false”]
    Display post full content. Parameter value “true” OR “false”. Default value “false”.

  • Content Words Limit:
    [pvkmnrs_category_tab content_words_limit=”20″]
    Display content words limit. You can enter numeric values.

  • Content Tail:
    [pvkmnrs_category_tab content_tail=”…”]
    Display three dots after the content.

  • Display Read More:
    [pvkmnrs_category_tab display_read_more=”true”]
    Display read more button. Parameter value “true” OR “false”. Default value “true”.

  • Read More Text:
    [pvkmnrs_category_tab read_more_text=”Read More”]
    Change “Read More” text to your Desired text.

  • All Tab Text:
    [pvkmnrs_category_tab all_tab_text=”All”]
    Change “All” text to your Desired text.

  • Link Target:
    [pvkmnrs_category_tab link_target=”self”]
    Choose link target. Parameter value “self” OR “blank”. Default value “self”.

  • Link Target:
    [pvkmnrs_category_tab link_target=”self”]
    Choose link target. Parameter value “self” OR “blank”. Default value “self”.

✅ Features Include:

  • Display Category Tab wise Post
  • Strong shortcode parameters
  • Fully responsive
  • 100% Multi language
sections.installation:
1. Upload the ‘Pvkmnrs Responsive Post with Category Tab’ folder to the ‘/wp-content/plugins/’ directory.
  2. Activate the “Pvkmnrs Responsive Post with Category Tab” list plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Add a new page and add desired short code in that.
sections.faq:
How can using category tab Shortcode?

Go to your WordPress wp-admin plugin section and find our plugin “Pvkmnrs Responsive Post with Category Tab”. please install and active plugin… Go to “Plugin Shortcode Details” menu inside “Post Tab” menu… Plugin shortcode and parameter information is avaialble on “Plugin Shortcode Details” menu…
